title: Malaria Smear Findings: Falciparum and Vivax Clues
subject: Microbiology
preview: Thick blood films improve sensitivity for malaria parasite detection; thin films help species identification and parasitemia assessment.
quickRevision: Thick blood films improve sensitivity for malaria parasite detection; thin films help species identification and parasitemia assessment.
Repeat sampling may be needed when initial microscopy is negative but clinical suspicion remains high.
Severity assessment and local drug-resistance guidance determine management.

sections.title: Pathophysiology & identification
points: Thick blood films improve sensitivity for malaria parasite detection; thin films help species identification and parasitemia assessment.
P. falciparum may show multiple delicate rings in one red cell and appliqué forms; P. vivax often enlarges infected red cells.

sections.title: Exam trap — avoid this mistake
points: Morphology has overlap; do not rely on one smear feature without laboratory quality control.
